narrative.overview:
The site is the classic minimal engineer page (one reading column of name, intro, links and plain lists) set down on a sheet of engineering computation paper. The paper does the designing: pale green stock, a faint full-bleed grid, graphite ink, blue-black links with a thin underline, and hairline rules. Nothing else competes with it. Content sits in a single 42rem column, and every structural mark is a 1px line.

Density is calm and editorial: generous vertical air measured in grid units, tight horizontal discipline. The memorable details are material rather than motion. The header is a ruled title-block strip of labelled cells, and each list entry carries a sheet number that hangs in the left margin outside the column, the way an engineer numbers pages. Dark mode is the same pad under a desk lamp: deep green-black stock with a dim grid. Print drops the paper and the chrome and keeps the column.

The world deliberately refuses the showy frontend portfolio (hero, cards, motion) and the anonymous white template. It is plain on purpose, but it is drawn, not default.
keyCharacteristics: One centred 42rem reading column; no multi-column layouts.
Full-bleed 1.5rem minor grid with 7.5rem majors, registered to the column.
Structure by 1px rules only: square corners, no shadows, no filled panels except code.
Three voices of type: humanist sans for reading, condensed uppercase for labels, mono for numbers.
One accent (blue-black ink) carried only by links, the current nav cell, focus and selection.
No signature motion; only colour and underline transitions.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Blue-black is reserved for interaction (links, current location, focus, selection). Static text, rules and labels stay in the green-graphite family.

rules.name: The Paper Is the Palette Rule
rules.body: Every neutral is a step of the same pale green sheet or its graphite. No white, no grey, no second hue.

rules.name: The No Display Face Rule
rules.body: Titles are the body family at 700. There is no separate display typeface, and no type larger than 2rem.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Any date, sheet number or count is set in the mono with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Registered Grid Rule
rules.body: The grid is not wallpaper: its minor lines meet the column edges. Any change to column width or grid offset must keep the column edges on grid lines.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: If something needs separation, rule it. Never lift it with a shadow, blur or overlay.

dos: **Do** measure vertical spacing in units of 1.5rem (u, 2u, 3u, 5u).
**Do** keep the minor grid registered to the column edges when changing column width or grid offset.
**Do** separate content with 1px rules: hairline between entries, strong under section heads and around the strip.
**Do** set every date, count and sheet number in the mono with tabular figures.
**Do** mark unconfirmed content with dashed rules and faint graphite rather than hiding it.
**Do** give every new colour role a lamp counterpart in both dark-theme blocks.
**Do** keep motion to colour and underline transitions at 160ms on the ease-out curve.
donts: **Don't** add rounded corners, shadows, or soft colour gradients. The only gradients in the system are the hard-stop 1px grid lines.
**Don't** box list entries into cards or filled panels; filled backgrounds are limited to the header strip's states and code.
**Don't** introduce a display typeface or type larger than 2rem.
**Don't** use blue-black for anything that is not interactive or the current location.
**Don't** add entrance, scroll or hover motion beyond colour and underline transitions.
**Don't** put a label above a page or post title; labels name fields, sections and sheet positions, never introduce headlines.
